title: Stack Scout // Updates
summary: Public-safe activity stream seeded from official or first-party sources.

items.title: Nearly half of AI research runs stuck with plan A, Bespoke Labs finds
items.summary: Bespoke Labs links new approaches to bigger validation-score gains; simply telling agents to switch more isn’t a proven fix.

items.title: OpenAI announces Daybreak tools for patching vulnerabilities and testing web apps
items.summary: OpenAI says its agents can prepare patches and test web applications, with engineers reviewing proposed fixes.

items.title: SOV-Transcribe-1 tops the open-weight speech-to-text ranking, says @ArtificialAnlys
items.summary: With a 2.3% AA-WER Index score, SOV-Transcribe-1 ranks seventh of 44 models overall, according to @ArtificialAnlys.

items.title: Perplexity’s Decider update cuts to the passage
items.summary: Arav Srinivas says Decider v1.3 and Decider Flash v1.3 find requested passages and show where they appear.

items.title: Replit Agent can now buy through Link, @jeff_weinstein says
items.summary: @amasad says Replit Agent can make business purchases, including ads aimed at acquiring new customers.

items.title: Aurora users say it does the annoying part: calling businesses
items.summary: Posts describe AI agents phoning local businesses, with users reporting AC-service results and a completed furniture pickup.

items.title: Democrats launch Nvidia investigation, write scathing letter on Huang’s ‘scheme’ with Trump
items.summary: This Congressional investigation into Nvidia's China sales and its dealings with Trump is the second one, so far, since news of the alleged spy affair broke.

items.title: Muse can now place calls to US businesses — if you pay
items.summary: Muse's AI can now place outbound calls to U.S. businesses — but it's not free.

items.title: willdepue claims six Chinese AI models carry Blackwell fingerprints
items.summary: willdepue says initial-weight patterns match Blackwell hardware, citing reproductions on a B300 and rented GB200.

items.title: Mira Murati says it’s release time for Inkling 2 Small’s weights
items.summary: Murati’s November 12 announcement credits her team and safety-testing partners, but doesn’t spell out licensing or download details.

items.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
items.summary: Jensen Huang has resigned from Nvidia following an affair, which could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.

items.title: Nebius tests the neocloud playbook with $40 billion in planned spending
items.summary: Nebius plans to fund its $40 billion AI infrastructure expansion through customer prepayments and loans, even as delays at a Microsoft data center raise questions about its financing model.

items.title: Jensen Huang was having a third affair, Reuters reports
items.summary: Reuters is withholding the name of the new employee linked to Huang, but says she is an employee of Nvidia.

items.title: Google’s latest Search upgrade promises better answers to your most complicated questions
items.summary: Powered by Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Google's AI Mode is getting better at understanding complex queries, surfacing relevant links, and delivering richer visual responses.

items.title: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Hydrogen, finally replacing 3.8 Flash
items.summary: Gemini 4 Hydrogen isn’t getting a slow, security-conscious release like Carbon and Argon.

items.title: Make opened its CLI to all users
items.summary: Make's 2026 release notes show the Make CLI becoming available to all users, continuing the platform's expansion beyond the browser UI.

items.title: GitHub MCP Server reached 1.0.0
items.summary: The official GitHub MCP server hit 1.0.0 with granular issue field tooling and broader MCP Apps support behind feature flags.

items.title: GitHub CLI 2.90.0 introduced `gh skill` in public preview
items.summary: The latest GitHub CLI release adds search, install, preview, update, and publish flows for portable agent skills.

items.title: Hugging Face added Kernels to the Hub
items.summary: The Hub changelog added Kernels as a new way to browse precompiled, hardware-specific kernels and also continues to push agent traces into the product story.

items.title: Strudel Studio's latest public pass focused on smoke-run reliability
items.summary: The recent manager-side pass caught and fixed a release-smoke issue while keeping the studio workflow moving forward.

items.title: Canvas Planner stayed clean and review-ready in its latest public pass
items.summary: The latest public-ready manager pass kept the board surface fast and uncluttered while tightening browser behavior.

items.title: Playwright MCP 0.0.70 landed as the latest maintenance release
items.summary: The current tagged release is a maintenance cut, while the docs continue to push Playwright MCP as a first-class browser layer for agent workflows.

items.title: n8n kept its March 2026 release line moving
items.summary: The March release notes show continued 1.12x shipping, while docs and blog updates highlight secrets-provider and workflow-hardening work.

items.title: OpenAI launched GPT-5.4
items.summary: GPT-5.4 arrived with native computer use, tool search, and 1M-token context, reinforcing OpenAI's focus on real agent workflows.

items.title: Perplexity doubled down on its product thesis in March 2026
items.summary: Perplexity's public blog framed 'The AI is the Computer' and kept tying that story to its API and device ambitions from late February.

items.title: Anthropic's current system-card set centers Claude Sonnet 4.6
items.summary: Anthropic's model materials list Claude Sonnet 4.6 as the current Sonnet generation and explicitly note API access among the active surfaces.

items.title: Wrangler 4.58.0 improved command grouping and auth ergonomics
items.summary: Cloudflare's Workers SDK release added grouped help categories, better auth token retrieval, and type generation on dev startup.
